# Claude of Legends — pinned upstream reference

- Repository: https://github.com/killian01/claude-of-legends
- Commit: `34fe718427d2726c92ed9063e694640e6d870013`
- License: MIT, copyright (c) 2026 Claude of Legends contributors; see the unmodified `LICENSE`.
- Selected gameplay definitions: Dain, Fenn, Ashvyn, Sylra.
- Retrieval date: 2026-11-27.

Files under `src/` are unmodified upstream source snapshots for attribution, exact numbers and implementation reference. They are not a separately installed application and do not form a complete build. `SOURCE.json` records their fixed upstream URLs and SHA-256 hashes.

The local port's units, level cap, rank unlock changes and other declared adaptations are documented in `../../docs/source-heroes.md`. This folder does not grant a license to unrelated third-party artwork; the local game keeps its independently attributed CC0 assets.
